EditorMetadata.Comment: Slice 1 proof: RequireAll parallel re-executes every child every tick as long as none has reached Success (RunsNeeded=100 keeps all three Running for the duration of the test), so SharedA/SharedB/Control all run in the same tick, deterministically in child order.

Slice 1: this node's WorkingState is bound (via WorkingStateTargetField) to 'bpSharedWorkingState', a Role=State/Scope=Behavior blackboard variable. Its OWN Params variable (bpParamsSharedA) stays private/Input, but the WorkingState slot key is now derived from the SHARED variable's name (FNV-1a(assetId, 'bpSharedWorkingState')), not this node's VisualId — so it resolves to the SAME partition slot as SharedB below.

Slice 1: a SECOND composed node, distinct VisualId and distinct Params variable (bpParamsSharedB), but its WorkingStateTargetField binds to the SAME 'bpSharedWorkingState' Behavior-scoped variable as SharedA. Both resolve to one shared partition slot -- each tick both nodes increment the SAME WorkingState.Ticks counter (race-free: one entity, sequential ticks within one Parallel evaluation).

Node-scoped control: no WorkingStateTargetField authored, so scope resolution falls back to ExpressionTargetField (Input role) -> Node scope, exactly like T31/T33/T34 pre-Slice-1 behavior. Its slot key is derived from THIS node's own VisualId (FNV-1a(assetId, nodeVisualId)), so it stays isolated from the shared slot even though it runs in the same Parallel and uses the same TickCore method.

Variables.Name: bpParamsSharedA
Variables.Comment: Private Params for SharedA. RunsNeeded=100 keeps this node Running for the whole test (never reaches Success), so the Parallel keeps re-executing it every tick.

Variables.Name: bpParamsSharedB
Variables.Comment: Private Params for SharedB. RunsNeeded=100 keeps this node Running for the whole test.

Variables.Name: bpParamsControl
Variables.Comment: Private Params for the Node-scoped control. RunsNeeded=100 keeps this node Running for the whole test.

Variables.Name: bpSharedWorkingState
Variables.Comment: Slice 1: Role=State/Scope=Behavior WorkingState host variable. SharedA and SharedB both bind WorkingStateTargetField to this variable's Name, so ResolveStatefulSlotKey computes the SAME FNV-1a(assetId, 'bpSharedWorkingState') slot key for both -- one shared partition slot, accumulated by both nodes each tick.
